documented_probe: C-13d03a72 (produce byte-identical converter output across independent runs): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: A compact procedural renderer task. Difficulty comes mostly from required generalization to arbitrary hidden scenes (the tool is re-run on multiple fresh inputs) plus byte-exact correctness: the deliverable must run, be a reusable program, handle clipped/off-canvas/zero-size/adverse geometry, respect painter order, and emit a deterministic P6 PPM matching the reference under binary byte comparison. Cannot be passed by copying a scene-specific answer, so fixed-output cheating is structurally impossible.
